answer: Clones pack votes if joining is instant. A recruit rents a berth in a rotating harbor of 12 auditors, locks 18 coins, and posts one unique work ticket each epoch, signed by two auditors on opposite sides of a trust bridge. Weight grows only after a five-epoch spiral of tickets lands on the public log. Another persona costs 18 more coins and a new auditor draw; copies fail, since each ticket embeds the address and a one-time berth id. Peers recompute hashes from the log and slash a mute berth. Collusion breaks it, so signers must come from disjoint cohorts and each caps tickets per epoch.
